title: Masala Roasted Carrot, Lentil & Feta Tacos with Tomato-Cucumber Salad

steps.text: Drain and rinse lentils, then transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Add carrots to the baking sheet with the lentils. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until carrots and lentils are warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice one lime into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl along with salt and coriander, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with warm lentil-carrot mixture and feta. Serve with salad on the side and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
